reasons.plausibility: Increasing particle size generally reduces deposition efficiency in thermal spray, contradicting the proposed mechanism, and larger particles are more likely to cause porosity and incomplete melting, undermining coating integrity.
reasons.testability: The proposed comparative experiment with clear measurements and a well-defined falsification criterion (statistically significant thickness increase without compromised integrity/oxidation) is well-designed and feasible.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a physically incorrect premise about particle size and deposition efficiency, leading researchers in the wrong direction.
